docs.text: There is not a lot that I miss about my former life before I moved to New England, but every time I see a picture of Lake Superior, I miss that a whole big lot.

I know I settled in the Great Lakes region, which is as close as it gets to heaven on earth, but the West occupies the most tender place in my heart and it’s deeply sad to lose the person younger than me who could still describe and depict it

when we were thinking about relocating it was up to the great lakes region or down to here and we went with florida because i was genuinely afraid the three san franciscans i was moving with would die

im kind of over living in the desert.. i spent the majority of my life on the great lakes and i miss the water, the beaches, the greenery, the wildlife. nothing can match my love for bodies of water. i need to get out of the desert
It’s the thing I miss most about living on the Great Lakes, yes

Home. Sigh. I so miss the Grand. I also miss the seasons, thunderstorms, the beautiful fall colours, and the Great Lakes. Hoping Duhg Ford goes away soon as I'd like to come home to retire. You live in the same hood as my sister & her boys.

I still live in that area and it's still amazing place to live. The only thing that would get me to move is if I could move to a coastal city, as I miss the Big Salt Seas and the freshwater Great Lakes don't hit me in the same way. (I grew up in rural FL right off the Atlantic.)
I love living here. I miss the Great Lakes in the summer though

I miss the Great Lakes, Algonquin, the seasons (especially fall), thunderstorms, seeing the stars across the entire sky...I was not a fan of the mountains and drear/lack of sun when I came out. It is more sunny now (due to climate change), and I have learned to like the mountains.
I miss my home state and the Great Lakes!

I used to live in FL. Graduated from Homestead HS in '82... love the beaches ⛱️ the temps, hate DeSantis & Palmetto Bugs!!! I have beaches ⛱️ here, plus 4 seasons - MI is the inland FL... no salt or sharks! Appreciate the offer, goes both ways. After 40 yrs, I'm a Gander Gurl now!! #LakeSuperior #UP
I miss the Great Lakes and the UP. 🙂
I still have the itch to move out to the PNW someday but I’d forever miss the Great Lakes if I did.
I left the great lakes and another in the desert...I feel you
I miss the Great Lakes region. Don’t know if I’ll ever have the opportunity to move back but it’s nice to see pictures.
I miss the Great Lakes in the summer. I'm a Lake Huron guy
I miss Iargo Springs in the fall. I miss tubing down the AuSable during the summers. I miss the campfires and bonfires of summer parties in the field. I miss the shores of Lake Huron.
Michigan I lived on Lake Michigan in Chicago for 20 plus years. I had a million dollar view facing east, lake Michigan. Fun times
I miss it sometimes. Traded up to Lake Huron from Lake Ontario.
between lake superior, michigan, and st. clair, for over 10 years now i’ve lived within a 15 minute drive to the coastline. i don’t think i can ever move away from one, now!
I escaped SC about 2.5 years ago. I returned to (near) the shores of the Great Lakes from whence I came. I hope you're as happy in your new home as I am in mine.

I miss Mexico, NY. I miss the dairy farms, the cheese, the ice cream, the more honest people, my family, Lake Ontario, Casey’s Cottage, Daddy Ed’s, Paulangelos pizza, the colorful houses, the random barns and how beautiful it is. I miss home a lot.
I grew up on the Great Lakes. Beautiful! I want to be in the Florida Keys.
Sometimes I really miss living in lake effect country
Man I miss the “Federal Government is boring and predictable” era already. Listening to the NOAA radio when I’m doing fieldwork. Blah blah blah in the nearshore waters of Lake Michigan. Poetry.
I do miss the Great Lakes something awful

Now I knew all that going in, but did that stop me? No. I wanted out of Louisiana and a particular dynamic and I moved to.....the shores of the Great Lakes and it took me a week to realize I was stuck in the exact same dynamic I left.
